subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI header logo/icon not displaying after 2026.3.24 update

question: Should OpenClaw support hard-refresh/bookmarked Control UI URLs under arbitrary or legacy non-tab prefixes when no gateway.controlUi.basePath is configured?
rationale: Current source fixes root, configured-basePath, and /__openclaw__/ public assets, but tests still preserve 404s for arbitrary prefixes such as /webchat/favicon.svg, so automation should not choose that route contract for maintainers.

options.title: Decide route contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical thread while a maintainer decides the supported URL contract before any new repair PR starts.

options.title: Support prefixed deep routes
options.body: Treat these hard-refresh/bookmark paths as supported and request a narrow fix that keeps public assets and module/CSS paths valid without weakening static-file safety.

options.title: Close unsupported prefixes
options.body: If only root, known routes, configured basePath, and /__openclaw__/ are supported, close this after documenting that boundary and resolving the linked fork PR.

recommendation.title: Decide route contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical thread while a maintainer decides the supported URL contract before any new repair PR starts.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points to steipete for both the original configurable Control UI base-path support and the later namespaced public-asset fix adjacent to this route contract.
